observed_contract: request_firmware_nowait copies the caller context into a separately allocated firmware_work object
the firmware work item is scheduled with schedule_work on the kernel system workqueue
the worker invokes the callback with the saved context and releases only the module and device references afterward
the API returns no work handle to the requesting driver for cancellation
driver remove is invoked during device_remove
device_unbind_cleanup then calls devres_release_all after the remove callback returns
the LED child device is created with led_cdev as driver data
devm LED registration installs an unregister release action

locations: devm_kmalloc and clientdata state initialization; ram_work_init call chain
remove has no firmware-request callback drain
0x5a98-0x5ac0 initialize delayed work callback at state+0x3c0 and queue it after 2000 ms
0x852c-0x8540 retry by queueing state+0x3c0 on system_wq
0x8768-0x87d4 dereference state operations and call get_ram_num

finding.title: asynchronous RAM firmware callback can outlive remove

paths.evidence: probe schedules delayed work at state+0x3c0; the worker passes work-0x3c0 as the raw context to request_firmware_nowait with ram_load as callback
a second stock request_firmware_nowait call also names ram_load as callback and derives its context from the LED child device driver-data pointer

teardown_interaction: aw_remove begins by canceling only the delayed work at state+0x3c0
request_firmware_nowait allocates and schedules a separate firmware_work item on the system workqueue; the driver receives no cancellation handle
the firmware worker invokes ram_load with the saved raw context; remove does not wait for that callback
driver-core devres_release_all runs after remove returns, releasing the devm state allocation
ram_load dereferences the state on success, and on failure it can queue delayed work at state+0x3c0 again while its retry counter is at most 0x14
finding.impact: The pending callback can access released device state or requeue work after remove already canceled the embedded delayed work.

limits: The conclusion is a static lifetime path from stock assembly and exact target-kernel source; no runtime race reproduction was performed.
No reconstruction source was changed, so this review required no Docker rebuild.
The exact callback ordering depends on scheduler timing; this report does not claim every remove triggers the path.
hardening_follow_up: Track outstanding firmware requests per device and ensure callback completion is part of the remove drain before devres releases state.
Prevent ram_load from touching hardware or requeueing delayed work after the device enters a dying state.
Apply the same callback lifetime tracking to every request_firmware_nowait caller, including the sysfs ram_update_store path.
